```{python}
#| include: false
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("data/readmissions.csv")
all_wards = df[df["ward"] == "All wards"].copy()
all_wards["after"] = all_wards["quarter"] >= "2025 Q1"
before = all_wards.loc[~all_wards["after"], "rate"].mean()
after = all_wards.loc[all_wards["after"], "rate"].mean()
change = round((after / before - 1) * 100)
```

## The question

Did the new discharge protocol reduce 30-day readmissions?

## What we found

Readmissions fell from `{python} f"{before:.1f}"`% to `{python} f"{after:.1f}"`%.

## Readmissions fell by `{python} abs(change)`% after the new protocol

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart of the 30-day readmission rate per quarter for all wards: about 18% in 2024, about 12% from 2025 Q1, when the new protocol started."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

colours = ["#003C7D" if a else "#b3b3b3" for a in all_wards["after"]]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
ax.bar(all_wards["quarter"], all_wards["rate"], color=colours, width=0.7)
ax.set_ylabel("30-day readmission rate (%)", fontsize=16)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=14)
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
ax.yaxis.grid(True, color="#e5e5e5")
ax.set_axisbelow(True)
plt.show()
```
